title: Blueprint | Agent loses access to another person's ticket right after running its transition
env: NDC-Staging · staging-desk · owner ndc-staging-owner + agent "Customer Experience Specialists 2" (CES2, normal member of Customer Support) signed in once · blueprint QA RT21 BP F04 tk · tickets #4997 (blueprint), #4998 (control)

panels.caption: 15:52Z CES2 opens #4997 (owner's ticket): read-only banner; QA onlyA is no longer offered — 'No transitions you can run'

rows: Normal agent, read-only on another person's ticket, owner of QA onlyA
Not offered in the UI ('No transitions you can run'); API run 403 BLUEPRINT_NOT_OWNER at 15:53:06Z; edit 403. r20 offered it and Run moved the ticket
Agent's access after the attempt + reload
Ticket still opens with the read-only banner; GET record/desk 200 before and after. The r20 loss could not be produced because the run is now refused
Where the read access comes from
Control #4998 (same owner, no blueprint) is 'This ticket is not available' / 403 for CES2, so CES2 reads #4997 only because it is a transition owner on its blueprint
